全球影响力投资

ImpactAlpha2026-10-07

家族办公室Ceniarth公开十年“影响力优先”成绩单：四年净IRR仅3.2%

8亿美元家族办公室Ceniarth揭露：十年投入逾3亿美元影响力优先资金，涵盖约90档基金与60笔直投，近四年净IRR 3.2%，扣除费用与通膨后实质约为零。罕见透明数据，可作家族配置基准。

Family office Ceniarth reveals break-even results from its impact-first portfolio

Ceniarth, an $800m family office, has deployed over $300m of impact-first capital across about 90 funds and 60 direct deals. Its four-year net IRR was 3.2%, roughly zero after costs and inflation; breaking even needs about 4.5% gross. Rare, candid data for families sizing impact allocations.

MacArthur Foundation2026-10-08

MacArthur基金会影响力投资额度扩大50%至7.5亿美元

MacArthur基金会将影响力投资配置提高50%至7.5亿美元，2027年起执行，回收资金滚动再投资，并延长至少6%捐赠支出承诺至2028年。大型基金会加码，显示影响力投资已成慈善常备工具。

学习单字
  • charitable payout慈善支出率：基金会每年用于捐赠与慈善活动的资产比例
  • lines of credit信用额度：可在核定上限内随时动用的融资安排
  • redeploy回收资金再投入：投资收回后将资金重新配置到新案件

MacArthur Foundation lifts its impact investment pool 50% to $750 million

The MacArthur Foundation is raising its impact investment allocation by 50% to $750m, starting in 2027, with repaid capital redeployed into new deals. It also extended its pledge to pay out at least 6% through 2028. A major foundation scaling up signals impact investing is now a core philanthropic tool.

Foundations including MacArthur provide subordinated debt; $35m is already lent. A blended structure showing how catalytic money can pave the way for commercial capital.

南韩公布K-GX战略，十年动员1,000兆韩元（约7,470亿美元），其中570兆韩元为政策性气候金融，230兆韩元预期来自民间；锁定钢铁、石化、半导体减碳，再生能源目标100GW。与台湾产业结构相近，值得对照。

学习单字
  • credit guarantees信用保证：由政府或机构为借款人债务提供担保，降低放款风险
  • regulatory incentives法规诱因：透过法规设计鼓励民间投入特定领域
  • industrial competitiveness产业竞争力：一国产业在国际市场的竞争能力

South Korea unveils K-GX strategy to mobilise 1,000 trillion won for green transformation

Seoul's K-GX strategy aims to mobilise 1,000tn won (about $747bn) over ten years: 200tn from budgets, 570tn in state-backed climate finance and 230tn from private projects. It targets steel, petrochemicals and chips, plus 100GW of renewables. A close benchmark for Taiwan's similar industrial mix.

学习单字
  • tokenised deposits代币化存款：以区块链代币形式表彰的银行存款，可用于链上即时交割
  • subscription ratios认购倍数：投资人认购金额相对于发行额的倍数
  • primary issuance初级发行：证券首次由发行人售予投资人的阶段

Hong Kong prices record $2.6 billion digital green bond

Hong Kong priced about HK$20bn ($2.6bn) of digital green bonds, the largest digital bond yet, in HKD, RMB, USD and euro tranches, 1.3 to 11.3 times subscribed. Tokenised deposits were used to settle the HKD tranche, merging green finance and tokenisation in Asia's sustainable capital hub.

The SEC will not pursue enforcement against BlackRock, State Street and others over Climate Action 100+, but warned that coordinated engagement could make large passive investors a 'group' holding over 5%, costing them simpler Schedule 13G filing status. A likely chill on collective climate stewardship.

Global venture funding reached $159B in Q3, down 25% from Q2 but up 53% year on year. A record 27 companies raised $1B+ rounds and AI took $102B, or 64%. The $679B nine-month total is the highest on record, showing capital piling into AI leaders.
